text: The local birdwatching society is organizing its annual spring census this weekend. Enthusiasts are invited to join the observation teams as we catalog the migratory species returning to the valley. The wetlands have seen an unusual increase in waterfowl this season, which should make for excellent viewing. Participants are advised to bring their own binoculars and wear weather-appropriate clothing. The group's coordinator will distribute the sector maps shortly before we begin the count.
